text: API requests are authenticated with Hawk, a cryptographic signing scheme that never transmits the secret key
quote: Hawk is a cryptographic scheme that ensures request integrity and authentication without transmitting your secret key.

text: Generate API keys from the Integrations section of the portal
quote: On the sidebar, select **Integrations** and click **Generate API Key**.

text: Webhooks push real-time HTTP POST notifications for account events such as pay-ins and payouts
quote: When something happens in your BVNK account, such as a pay-in or a payout, the platform sends an HTTP POST request to a URL you provide with the event details in real time.

text: Client-side tool to validate BVNK webhook signatures without sending sensitive data to external servers
quote: The BVNK Webhook Signature Validator is a client-side tool that helps developers verify webhook signatures from BVNK's payment processing system.

text: Sandbox mirrors production with test data so integrations can be validated without financial risk
quote: The sandbox environment mirrors production but operates with test data, allowing you to build and validate your integration without financial risk.

text: Simulate pay-ins with different currencies and payment methods in the sandbox via API
quote: To simulate pay-ins with different currencies and payment methods, in the sandbox environment, send the [`POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation`]

text: Sandbox gives a consistent simulation experience for both pay-ins and payouts
quote: The sandbox environment provides a consistent simulation experience for pay-ins and payouts across all customer accounts.

text: Create and manage crypto and fiat wallets for your own account or for customers via Portal or API
quote: On BVNK, you can create and manage both crypto and fiat wallets through the Portal or API. Specify a customer's ID and reference to create wallets for them; otherwise, the wallet is created for your own account.

text: Create rules linking a fiat virtual account to a crypto address to automatically on-ramp incoming fiat to crypto
quote: To create a rule that links a fiat virtual account to a crypto blockchain address, send the `POST /payment/v1/rules` request

text: Automatically on-ramp fiat to crypto and send it to blockchain addresses
quote: Automatically on-ramp to crypto and send to blockchain addresses.

text: Transfers v3 API handles wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, replacing the legacy Quote API
quote: The Transfers v.3 API replaces the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion.

text: Transfers v3 offers a single-field status model, digest-based quote acceptance and mandatory idempotency
quote: currency conversion is now a property of a transfer. Migrating to v.3 provides a single-field status model, digest-based quote acceptance, mandatory idempotency

text: Legacy webhooks stay fully supported with unchanged payloads while you migrate to new events
quote: This webhook is still fully supported, and its payload has not changed. You can switch to the new event whenever you are ready.

text: Partners can add markup fees to their customers' transactions to earn revenue
quote: As a partner, you can add a markup fee to your customers' transactions, enabling you to collect additional revenue from your customers.

text: Embedded Wallets give partners payment and fund-management features inside their own branded platform
quote: Embedded Wallets provide partners with seamless payment and fund management capabilities directly within their platform while maintaining their branding.

text: Accept stablecoin payments from customers and receive fiat in your account
quote: Crypto converted and received in fiat: Accept stablecoin payments from customers and receive fiat currency in your account

text: Each payment gets a live quote and a unique blockchain address for the customer to pay to
quote: For every payment, BVNK generates a live quote to be accepted by the customer and a unique blockchain address for the payment to be made to.

text: Channels give a permanent, reusable blockchain address that can receive crypto or stablecoins at any time
quote: A channel is a unique, repeated-use blockchain address that can receive crypto or stablecoins at any time. The address never changes.

text: Create USD, EUR and GBP virtual accounts for your business or customers
quote: Create virtual accounts in USD, EUR, GBP for your business or customers.

text: Customer-enabled wallets can make bank payouts using their virtual account, to first or third parties
quote: It is possible to create both a payout to themselves (first party) or a payout to another bank account (third party).

text: Send stablecoins or cryptocurrencies from your BVNK account
quote: Send stablecoins or cryptocurrencies from your BVNK account.

text: Fund in fiat to send stablecoins, or fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat
quote: Use your fiat balance to send stablecoins, or fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat.

text: Link virtual cards to stablecoin balances
quote: Link virtual cards to stablecoin balances.

text: Earn built-in rewards on idle balances
quote: Put idle balances to work with built-in rewards.

text: Send, receive, store and convert funds across 130+ countries
quote: Send, receive, store, and convert funds across 130+ countries.

text: Subscribe to a webhook event that signals ledger reports are ready
quote: In the **Events** field, specify `bvnk:ledger:report:ready` to enable the receiving of reports.

text: Card webhooks sync card lifecycle state: created, activated, frozen, cancelled
quote: Use this webhook to sync card state into your system whenever a card is created, activated, frozen, cancelled, or otherwise updated.

text: Card spending webhooks track card transaction activity in real time
quote: Use this webhook to track card spending activity and update your records in real time.

text: Webhook fires when a channel transaction is confirmed on chain and processed
quote: triggered when a new channel transaction is confirmed on chain, and the transaction has been processed.

text: Webhook fires when crypto arrives after a payment has expired or already completed
quote: Triggered when a cryptocurrency transaction is received after the payment has expired or been completed.

text: Webhook fires when extra information is needed to comply with the Travel Rule for a crypto payment
quote: Triggered when additional information is required to comply with the Travel Rule for a related crypto payment.

text: Webhook reports customer verification status changes: INFO_REQUIRED, PENDING, VERIFIED, REJECTED
quote: Triggered when a customer's status changes to `INFO_REQUIRED`, `PENDING`, `VERIFIED`, or `REJECTED`.

text: Wallet webhooks sync wallet records whenever wallet changes occur
quote: Use this webhook to sync wallet records into your system as soon as wallet changes occur.

text: Onboard customers to BVNK services directly through your own platform
quote: Onboard your first customer to BVNK services directly through your platform.

text: Direct-contract model lets businesses use BVNK through the portal or API for their own payment flows
quote: You contract directly with BVNK and access payment capabilities through the BVNK portal or API for your own use. You maintain full control over your payment flow
